subject: Draft MAP for Aperture Systems — co-edit and proposed timeline
messages:
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwoodinference.com>
To: Sarah Chen <sarah.chen@aperture.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Fri, 4 Sep 2026 14:02:00 -0700
Subject: Draft MAP for Aperture Systems — co-edit and proposed timeline

Hi Sarah,

Good to meet yesterday — thanks again for the time. Per our discussion, I'm sharing a lightweight Mutual Action Plan template and a first-pass MAP I started with the milestones we talked through. The idea is to jointly edit this living doc so the internal stakeholders at Aperture and our team have a single source of truth for the evaluation and close timeline.

Attachments/links:
- Redwood_MAP_template_v2.gdoc (Google Doc)
- https://docs.google.com/document/d/1aB...map-template (doc link)

Quick asks:
- Could you add the names/titles of the Aperture reviewers (security, SRE, product) in the "Stakeholders" section?
- Confirm whether a 6-week pilot (start 9/20) fits your timeline or if you need it shortened to 4 weeks.
- If we can get procurement folks on an initial call next week, we'll surface any paperwork early.

Proposed timeline (high-level):
1) Week 0 (9/20): Kickoff + environment access
2) Weeks 1–3: Feature evaluation and sample workload
3) Week 4: Cost/latency review and configuration
4) Week 5–6: Pilot wrap + decision meeting

I added a few suggested success criteria in the doc — feel free to overwrite. Marissa will coordinate technical setup and Monica will own procurement readiness.

Thanks — I'll leave the doc open for comments.

Best,
Karthik Iyer
Senior Solutions Engineer
Redwood Inference
Attachments: Redwood_MAP_template_v2.gdoc
From: Sarah Chen <sarah.chen@aperture.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Fri, 4 Sep 2026 16:10:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Draft MAP for Aperture Systems — co-edit and proposed timeline

Karthik,

Thanks for putting this together. I've added our initial stakeholder list (product: Daniel Park; SRE: Leila Gomez; security: Michael Ortiz) in the doc and uploaded a short XLS with pilot workload notes to the same folder (aperture_prio-stakeholders.xlsx).

Two items:
- We prefer a 4-week pilot (tighter budget cycle). Can we compress evaluation steps — maybe combine the feature eval and cost review into a rolling checkpoint?
- Procurement can join a 30-minute call on Mon 9/7 at 10am PT. Monica, does that work for you?

I'll make inline comments on acceptance criteria.

Sarah

Subject: Re: Draft MAP for Aperture Systems — co-edit and proposed timeline

Thanks Sarah — 4-week pilot is doable. Proposed compressed milestones:
- Week 0 (9/20): Kickoff + data access + sample dataset ingest
- Week 1: Functional test cases + perf baseline
- Week 2: Cost/latency optimization and KB/quantization config
- Week 3: Business review + go/no-go

I'll put these into the MAP doc and create a brief "deliverables by week" table so procurement and SRE can see what's required each week. For the Mon 9/7 procurement sync — Monica, Karthik and I can make 10am PT; I will invite our infra lead (internal) to cover networking checks.

Attachments: aperture_prio-stakeholders.xlsx (uploaded by Aperture)

Best,
Marissa Cole
Account Executive
Redwood Inference

Sarah —

Thanks for the update and for adding stakeholders. We've updated the MAP doc with the compressed 4-week timeline and a "Who owns which deliverable" table. Link below:
- MAP (read/edit): https://docs.google.com/document/d/1aB...map-template
- Pilot workbook: https://drive.google.com/file/d/1Xc...aperture-prio

Next steps:
- Monica to lead procurement sync (Mon 9/7, 10am PT)
- Marissa to create week-by-week deliverables table by EOD Mon 9/7
- Aperture to confirm final list of reviewers by 9/8

If that all looks right I'll convert the doc into the MAP slide template for execs after the procurement sync so we have a one-slide summary for your leadership.

Thanks,
